description: Add comprehensive TypeScript type definitions for GitHub integration functionality to the common library. This will provide type safety for GitHub-related operations across the codebase, including repository management, webhook handling, and authentication flows. The types should be exported from the common library for use in both frontend and backend components.
functional_requirements: Define TypeScript interfaces for GitHub repository data including name, owner, permissions, and visibility status
Create types for GitHub webhook payloads covering common events like push, pull request, and repository creation
Add authentication-related types for GitHub OAuth flows including token responses and user profile data
Ensure all types are properly exported from the common library's main entry point
Include validation types for GitHub API responses with proper error handling structures
Add documentation comments to all type definitions explaining their purpose and usage
